description: This file defines a Dart class 'Stats' that encapsulates gameplay statistics such as games played, wins, streaks, and guess distribution for a Wordle-like game. It includes methods for serialization to/from JSON and computing the win rate.

classes.name: Stats
classes.description: A class that maintains gameplay telemetry and distribution metrics, with functionality for JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: winRate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the win rate as a percentage.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Stats object into a JSON-compatible map.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a Stats object from a JSON map.
